data.description: Business payload returned by the controller handler

allowPublicUse.description: Whether this testimonial can be displayed publicly

feedback.description: Breakdown of feedback for various categories

area.description: The functional or design area needing revision

description.description: High-level summary of why the revision is needed
description.example: Social login is failing on mobile devices.

details.description: Detailed list of specific changes or fixes required

attachments.description: Array of media/file UUIDs related to the revision request (e.g., screenshots)

dueDate.description: Desired completion date for the requested revisions

content.description: The textual content of the message
content.example: Can you please update the logo color?

title.description: Short title for the feedback entry
title.example: Feedback from client about overall experience

feedback.description: Detailed feedback text from the client

status.description: New status for the project. Operator aliases: PAUSED→ON_HOLD, ACTIVE→IN_PROGRESS.

reason.description: Internal administrative reason for the status change

notifyClient.description: Whether to send a notification to the client about this status change

description.description: The detailed scope of the project
description.example: Refactoring the entire backend to use NestJS.

quoteId.description: Identifier of the accepted quote backing this project

clientId.description: Client user id who owns this project

description.description: Optional longer description of the project

description.example: Rebuild storefront with new checkout flow.

unitPrice.description: Unit price in major currency units (e.g. rupees)

description.example: Scope covers design, build, and QA.

scope.description: Optional scope JSON copied from source

sourceProjectId.description: Source project UUID used as template

lifecycle.description: Only quote_draft is supported in v1 (client must approve quote)

memberId.description: Identifier of the team member to associate with the project

amount.description: Milestone amount in smallest currency unit. Ignored (forced to 0) when the project already has a payment schedule — delivery milestones are non-billable.

dueDate.description: Optional due date for this milestone (ISO 8601)

newDeadline.description: New target end date for the project (ISO 8601)

reason.description: Reason for extending the project deadline

title.description: Override title for the portfolio draft

promoteMediaIds.description: Deliverable media IDs to promote into the portfolio gallery

userId.description: Client id from auth (seed users may use non-UUID ids e.g. test-user-002).
